details: For every finite binary class, $\mathrm{sd}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{VC}^{*a}(\mathcal H)-2$.
proof: Lemma 2 of the cited paper constructs an antipodal sphere of dimension $d-2$ from a dually antipodally shattered set of size $d$.
witness_verification: For the universal class, dual antipodal VC dimension is n, while spherical dimension is at most n-1. Hence the two endpoint parameters are strictly separated for every n.
name: Spherical Dimension / Dual Antipodal VC Dimension (affine)
